CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 0260b62dbcdbef574aafb9f1972d3abc54f0f5c3. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 0260b62dbcdbef574aafb9f1972d3abc54f0f5c3 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r8, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-merge-subject-harden-r8 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r8; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from PR #2697 head e73424f247781b8d5e55abe52f54d7005cb51f39 (branch fix/r10-merge-subject-harden; handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r7 tip 0260b62dbcdbef574aafb9f1972d3abc54f0f5c3, body ref handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r7). Do not restart from main; merge origin/main first. Round 8 after round 7 was blocked class-open (read git show origin/review/2697:VERDICT.md and origin/verdict/2697): a shell case-arm writer `  never) gh pr merge "$n" --squash --subject "..." ;;` is counted as a merge call but its subject goes unread (refused=0 at the head, 683dd52c and d0d35231) while the `(never)` spelling of the same arm is refused=1.
Owner ruling under the mandate: the THREE-ROUND SPLIT. Re-cut the body minimal and NARROW the PR's stated class to the spellings the diff closes, with a rule that enumerates them (a table in the body of each closed spelling and the mechanism that refuses it). Do not widen the guard to chase the case-arm. The shell case-arm writer (`never) ... ;;` without the open paren) is named in the body as `Carry: R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-CASEARM` (a new group, S, after R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-HARDEN, which the roster seat adds before this is pooled), with a failing test for it, marked as that group's (xfail or a clearly named expected-fail case in the harness with the group id in its name), so the open spelling is pinned as open rather than silently passing. The reviewer will check that the narrowed class is closed under its own rule: every spelling the body claims closed is refused at the head and was not at 683dd52c (null control), and the case-arm is the only named residual.
Run structure.py to exit 0 at the final head; re-take every figure at the final head; run prepr --body-check to green. Push exactly two refs: handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r8 and handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r8.
no host or home paths in anything you push
Class-rule text for the new group's carry, to put in the body and in the failing test: R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-CASEARM (roster cfb203cab) owns every shell case-arm spelling of a merge writer: with and without the leading paren (`never) ...` and `(never) ...`), at any indentation, and multi-pattern arms (`a|b) gh pr merge ... ;;`). The roster has no brief field for it, so this text is its brief: the failing test enumerates those spellings and is marked as the group's.
